extraction.method: Red vector strokes clustered by proximity, paired with the underlying PDF text layer; handwriting transcribed visually from 170 dpi page renders (440 dpi crops for ambiguous marks).
extraction.caveat: The handwriting has no text encoding, so every 'note' field is a human-legibility judgement. Check 'confidence' and 'needs_review' before acting on an item unreviewed.

Some items are already addressed (e.g. commit 1121f9b moved the author's red notes to source comments; fb29a55 generated the missing GP figures). field_guide.kind: Type of correction. 'query' = advisor questioned/underlined without prescribing a fix; 'structural_note' = chapter/section level instruction; the rest are literal edits.
field_guide.anchor: The thesis text the mark attaches to. Verbatim quote when anchor_is_verbatim is true; otherwise a description.
field_guide.note: Transcription of what is actually written/drawn in red.
field_guide.action: Interpretation of what to do. Derived, not quoted.
field_guide.confidence: high | medium | low — legibility and interpretive certainty of the transcription.
field_guide.needs_review: Present when the mark could not be read with confidence. Do not auto-apply these.
field_guide.anchor_found_in_current_source: Filename under written_files/tesis_escrito/ where the anchor still matches, or null.
